senses.gloss: m. (גּזַם) a figure of speech, hyperbole.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 104b:10">B. Mets. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ בעלמא הוא דקגזים</he> he used only a hyperbolical expression (‘a thousand Zuz’).

<cite ref="Arakhin 11a:5">Arakh. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>וסימנך מתניתא ג׳</he> and thy mnemotechnical sign (to remember who said a hundred and who a thousand) be: the Boraitha (or Mishnah) frequently uses hyperboles.
